task_metadata.research_topic: antibody-antigen binding affinity scoring with frozen protein language model features
task_metadata.research_question: Design a scoring head that predicts antibody-antigen binding affinity from pretrained protein language model features.
notes: AbBiBench is the benchmark anchor for the three test splits.

All baselines and the target protocol are zero-shot likelihood over frozen ESM-2 3B (facebook/esm2_t36_3B_UR50D), matching the AbBiBench paper protocol; delta_mlp here denotes WT-normalized delta log-likelihood, not a supervised head.

tests.label: influenza
tests.notes: AbBiBench influenza split plus an influenza bnAb paper.

tests.label: sars
tests.notes: AbBiBench benchmark split plus a SARS-CoV-2 mutational-scan paper.

tests.label: her2
tests.notes: AbBiBench benchmark split plus an HER2/4D5 binding paper.

baselines.name: esm2_pll
baselines.notes: ESM-2 embeddings and zero-shot mutation scoring.

baselines.name: masked_marginal
baselines.notes: Approximate masked-marginal style mutation scoring plus benchmark context from ProteinGym.

baselines.name: delta_mlp
baselines.notes: Generic supervised embedding head mapped to broader protein representation learning and alignment-free design papers.
